name: Por Favor El Cajon
notes: All 3 photos are clear, printed laminated menu pages covering Combinaciones/Botanas/Ensaladas/Especiales del Mar sections; no overlap between photos, all merged.

dishes.name: Taquitos Rancheros
dishes.description: Three corn tortillas rolled and stuffed with shredded seasoned beef. Topped with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, guacamole and sour cream. Served with beans and rice.

dishes.name: La Grande
dishes.description: Beef taco, chile relleno, cheese enchilada, refried beans and rice.

dishes.name: El Bandido
dishes.description: Beef taco, verde cheese enchilada, rojo chicken enchilada, refried beans and Mexican rice.

dishes.name: Los Burritos
dishes.description: Two beef burritos topped with our special cheese sauce and shredded jack and cheddar cheese on top. Served with refried beans and Mexican rice.

dishes.name: Enchiladas Verdes
dishes.description: Two cheese enchiladas cooked in our special tomatillo sauce (green tomatoes), includes sour cream, ortega chiles and a side of refried beans.

dishes.name: Enchiladas Rancheras
dishes.description: Two beef enchiladas topped with green chiles in our special tomatillo sauce. Topped with two kinds of cheese and sour cream. Served with a side of refried beans.

dishes.name: Enchiladas Suizas
dishes.description: Two tortillas dipped in our special tomatillo sauce, stuffed with shredded, seasoned chicken, then rolled and topped with more sauce, melted cheese and sour cream. Served with beans.

dishes.name: Beef Taco with Rice and Beans
Chile Relleno with Rice and Beans
Bean Burrito with Rice and Beans
Botana San Lucas
dishes.description: Mini taquitos made with seasoned shredded chicken. Topped with guacamole, tomatoes, lettuce, sour cream, and a side of refried beans.

dishes.name: Cheese Quesadilla
dishes.description: Soft or crisp tortilla topped with cheese and guacamole.

dishes.name: Quesadilla Lupita
dishes.description: Crisp flour tortilla underneath a soft flour tortilla with tender seasoned chicken inside. Topped with cheese, guacamole and sour cream.

dishes.name: Guacamole Dip
dishes.description: Fresh home made guacamole, served with chips.

dishes.name: Nacho Loco
dishes.description: Tortilla chips topped with melted cheese, chorizo, chile strips, enchilada sauce, sour cream, guacamole, beans and shredded beef.

dishes.name: Flautas
dishes.description: Flour tortillas fried golden brown, filled with seasoned shredded chicken and topped with lettuce, Pico de gallo, cotija cheese, sour cream and guacamole.

dishes.name: Fajita Quesadilla
dishes.description: Fajitas (beef, chicken or carnitas) sautéed with bell peppers, onions and tomatoes, served inside a flour tortilla with melted cheese and side of guacamole.

dishes.name: Queso Fundido
dishes.description: Melted cheese seasoned with salsa espanola, with ortega chiles on top. Served with tortillas.

dishes.name: Caesar Salad
dishes.description: Crisp romaine lettuce with parmesan cheese, tortilla strips and Caesar dressing.

dishes.name: Tostada Especial
dishes.description: Super salad on a crisp flour tortilla shell, filled with beans, shredded beef, shredded lettuce, tomato and two kinds of cheese. All topped with sour cream and guacamole.

dishes.name: Tostada Fiesta
dishes.description: A flour crown shell tortilla filled with beans, shredded lettuce, tomatoes, and two kinds of cheese. Topped with sour cream, guacamole and your choice of dressing.

dishes.name: Beef or Chicken Tostada
dishes.description: A crispy corn tortilla topped with (beef or chicken) beans, lettuce, tomatoes and two kinds of cheese. All topped with guacamole, sour cream.

dishes.name: Avocado Grande
dishes.description: Chicken breast, black beans, avocado slices, tomatoes, cheese and a hard-boiled egg on a bed of fresh chopped romaine lettuce. All served in a flour tortilla shell.

dishes.name: Tostada de Pollo
dishes.description: Tostada topped with beans, lettuce, tomatoes, cheese and chicken breast. Served with rice.

dishes.name: Chicken Tortilla Soup
dishes.description: Bowl served with tortillas. Cup $7, Bowl $11.

dishes.name: Black Bean Soup
dishes.description: Bowl served with tortillas. Cup $7, Bowl $11.

dishes.name: Pozole Soup
dishes.description: Bowl served with tortillas. Cup $7, Bowl $11.

dishes.name: Rellenos a la Vera Cruz
dishes.description: Two open chile rellenos stuffed with camarones (shrimp) simmered in a spicy sauce of tomatoes, onions and garlic. Covered with melted monterey jack cheese. Served with refried beans and Mexican rice.

dishes.name: Camarones a la Mexicana
dishes.description: Made with tomatoes, onion, garlic and chiles, combined with shrimp. Served with refried beans, Mexican rice and tortillas. Choice of flour or corn tortillas.

dishes.name: Two Fish Tacos
dishes.description: Fresh grilled pollock filets served on crisp or soft flour tortillas, topped with guacamole, salsa verde, lettuce, tomatoes, cheese with a side of rice.

dishes.name: Enchiladas del Mar
dishes.description: Two tortillas dipped, one in our special tomatillo sauce, one in our red sauce. Filled with savory shrimp and sautéed in butter and spices. Topped with an ortega chile and slices of avocado. Served with a side of beans and sour cream.

dishes.name: Sonora Fundido
dishes.description: Crispy folded flour tortilla covered with melted cheese. Inside is shrimp sautéed Sonora style with onions, bell peppers and rice. Served with salsa verde, sour cream and slices of avocado.

dishes.name: Chimichanga
dishes.description: Large flour tortilla filled with shredded beef, seasoned chicken and beans. Deep fried and garnished with two sauces with cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, sour cream and guacamole.

dishes.name: Cheese Crisp Special
dishes.description: Crisp flour tortilla topped with beans, shredded beef, two kinds of melted cheese, avocado slices, tomatoes, guacamole and an olive.

dishes.name: Carne Asada Burrito
dishes.description: Seasoned top sirloin steak with beans, rice and salsa fresca inside. Topped with our mild Colorado sauce, melted cheese and avocado slices.

dishes.name: Pollo Asada Burrito
dishes.description: Filled with sliced chicken breast, beans, rice and salsa fresca. Served with melted cheese and avocado slices with Colorado sauce on top.

dishes.name: Carnitas Burrito
dishes.description: Tender pork with beans and rice, salsa fresca inside. Topped with our mild Colorado sauce and melted cheese on top. Garnished with guacamole.

dishes.name: Shredded Chicken or Beef Burrito
dishes.description: Seasoned shredded chicken or beef with beans and rice inside. Topped with our famous enchilada sauce and melted cheese on top. Served with sour cream and guacamole on the side.
